title: Missouri: symbols overview

definition: Missouri's official symbols: white hawthorn blossom, eastern bluebird, flowering dogwood, and more.
description: The official symbols of Missouri — the "Show-Me State" — tell the state's story in shorthand: the white hawthorn blossom (flower), the eastern bluebird (bird), the flowering dogwood (tree), the motto "Salus populi suprema lex esto (The welfare of the people shall be the supreme law)," and the flag.
